items.t: 33% Upside for Ford? DZ Bank Thinks So, and Here’s How It Gets to $15
items.sum: Key TakeawaysDZ Bank upgraded Ford to Buy from Hold on Nov. 19 and cut its price target to $15 from $16, 33% above that day’s close.

items.t: Ford vs GM vs Stellantis: how the three Detroit automakers compare
items.sum: Investing.com -- The ranking is clear: General Motors (GM) leads on profitability, Ford Motor (F) leads on income, while Stellantis (STLA) offers the largest valuation gap—but with the weakest operating evidence.

items.t: Ford And GM Saved By US Government, Again
items.sum: Jim Farley says Chinese EVs would put Ford out of business, and Washington is building a wider moat to keep them away. But Detroit's real weakness lies far from American shores, and Europe already shows what could come.
